explain.text: I actually enjoy books, and I've even got two new ones on my desk right now. Sometimes, I even put one beside my bed, thinking I'll read it before I sleep. But most evenings, I am too tired after homework, football practice, and helping my parents. On weekends, I often plan to read, but something else always comes up. So at the moment, I hardly read at all.

My parents keep telling me that reading is important, and I agree with them, really. I sometimes read short stories for school, and I can finish them if I have to. But when I have free time, I'd much rather play basketball or watch videos about sports. Books are okay, but they don't excite me as much as doing something active with my friends.

I used to read a lot in my bedroom when I was younger, especially before going to sleep. But these days, I don't really read at home anymore because my phone is always next to me. The only time I read properly is on the bus in the morning. My journey to school takes about 30 minutes, so I usually bring a novel with me and read a few pages before class.

Some of my friends read on the train or bus, but I can't do that because it makes me feel a bit sick. I also don't like reading in the living room because the TV is usually on. For me, the best place is my bed. I read there almost every night, even if it's only for 10 minutes. It helps me relax and forget about school for a while.
